name: Form.md
title: documents, databases and realtime editing in a single binary
summary: A self-hosted workspace where people and AI agents write documents, run databases and edit together in realtime, as one Go binary with one SQLite file.
lede: Form.md is a self-hosted workspace where people and AI agents write documents, run databases and edit together in realtime. It ships as one static Go binary with its web client embedded and one SQLite file beside it: no database server, no cache, no object store. The server holds the real collaborative document, so an agent's edit merges into what a person is typing instead of resetting it.
runs_on: macOS, Windows and Linux as a desktop app, or as a server binary
checks: Writes pages in a block editor with a slash menu, Markdown shortcuts, mentions, toggles, callouts, tables, columns and code in 29 highlighted languages.
Runs databases where every row is a page, with 21 property types and table, board, list, gallery, calendar, timeline and form views.
Lets agents edit beside people through an MCP server with OAuth 2.1 sign-in, with edits that merge with live typing.
Shares with six access levels, comments, suggested edits, history, publishing to the web and an audit log.

facts.dd: One static Go binary (37 MB) with pure-Go SQLite and a server-side CRDT
Vanilla TypeScript and Vite on ProseMirror and Yjs, no UI framework
26, for the whole window and its mail
90 in eleven categories, plus 14 example projects

chapters.title: A block editor with realtime co-editing
chapters.text: Every page body is a CRDT that the server applies and reads itself, so a Markdown write over the API merges with what people are typing. The server renders the body into the first frame, so a reload shows the text before any script runs.

chapters.title: Every row is a page
chapters.text: 21 property types including status, relations with two-way sync, rollups and formulas, shown as seven views on one query engine with nested AND/OR filters, multi-sort and groups. The README reports 20,000 rows scrolling at a 54 ms p95 step under 4x CPU and 500 kbps throttling.

chapters.title: Agents edit beside people
chapters.text: An MCP server with OAuth 2.1 sign-in, consent per workspace and read or write scope. Agents address blocks by id, show as a named cursor and group edits into runs that undo in one click, and a replace of the block you are typing in is refused until you move on.

features.title: Desktop app
features.text: A Tauri 2 window around the same server binary, which it starts on this computer and stops when you quit.
bullets: form.md.app and a .dmg on macOS
.deb, .rpm and .AppImage on Linux
.msi and a setup .exe on Windows
You are signed in as the owner without a password

features.title: Workspace shell
features.text: A page-first layout with a resizable sidebar, breadcrumbs that list sibling pages and a Home page.
bullets: Search, Home, Library, favorites, shared spaces and your pages in the sidebar
Back and forward, tabs, tags, trash, covers and icons, uploads
Home with a greeting, a drop area, recently visited cards and templates
Phone editing with a block toolbar above the on-screen keyboard

features.title: Block editor
features.text: Slash menu, Markdown shortcuts, a drag handle with turn into and a selection toolbar with colours.
bullets: @ and [[ mentions of pages, people and dates
Code in 29 highlighted languages, tables, columns, media and PDF
A live table of contents and backlinks under the body
Image annotations with arrows, boxes, ellipses, freehand lines and text
Boards: a moodboard block for pictures, notes and link cards

features.title: Databases
features.text: Rows are pages, answered by the server, so a filter on a formula works on 20,000 rows.
bullets: 21 property types with relations, rollups and formulas
Table, board, list, gallery, calendar, timeline and form views
Heatmap, graph, map and feed views
Kanban with column totals, progress bars and card limits
CSV import of 20,000 rows in about a second and export of any view

features.title: Forms and automations
features.text: Public forms built from a database's properties, and automations that react to rows.
bullets: Required and conditional questions, a public link that needs no account
Each submission kept whole as one response record
Automations on a row added, a response received, a property changed or a schedule
Buttons in pages and a button property in databases

features.title: Charts and dashboards
features.text: Charts are computed by the server from the same query engine, so filters and access rules hold.
bullets: Bar, line, area, donut, radial, gauge, histogram, dot plot, period comparison, matrix and calendar heatmaps
Dashboards of small, medium and wide cards rearranged by drag
KPI cards with a sparkline and the change
PNG and SVG export

features.title: Sharing and collaboration
features.text: Six access levels from view to full access, enforced by the server on every route including the sync socket.
bullets: Open, closed and private teamspaces, groups, guests by email
Share links with expiry and password
Comment threads and suggest mode with accept or reject per change
An inbox with browser push and an email fallback
SCIM, SAML, webhooks and an audit log

features.title: History and offline
features.text: Versions are kept while editing and before every restore, and a restore merges into the live document.
bullets: Preview and a block diff
The 20 pages and databases opened most recently are kept on the device
A database kept offline keeps up to 1000 rows and their row pages
Rows added, edited or deleted offline are sent when you are back

features.title: Publish to the web
features.text: A page and its subpages as a site at its own slug or a custom domain.
bullets: Server-rendered with the editor's own markup
SEO fields, themes, fonts, an optional password, indexing control and a sitemap
Views and unique viewers per page and per workspace over time

features.title: AI in the workspace
features.text: Bring your own models: Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini or any OpenAI-compatible server such as Ollama or vLLM.
bullets: /ai in the slash menu: rewrite, fix, shorten, change tone, explain, summarize, translate
AI blocks and AI autofill properties
A workspace agent and custom agents that run on a schedule or on changes, each run undoable
Meeting notes with a transcript, summary and action items
Keys sealed in the database, an owner allow-list and per-person hourly limits

features.title: Claude Code inside
features.text: A bottom panel with real terminals and a Claude Code chat that shows each tool call as it runs.
bullets: Claude Code tabs already connected to this instance's MCP tools
Hand a chat to a terminal tab or bring one back
Agents list and run window commands through MCP, REST or form-md cli

features.title: Search and commands
features.text: Search with filters and sorts, and a command finder for every action in the app.
bullets: Title-only, created-by, shared-space, in-page and date filters with five sorts
Find a command with Ctrl+Shift+P
Find and replace in a page
A shortcuts sheet where any key can be changed

features.title: Style and preferences
features.text: Page styles and themes applied before the first frame.
bullets: 14 dark and 6 light theme profiles, nine accent colours or your own
Six fonts plus uploaded fonts (WOFF2, WOFF, TTF, OTF)
Three densities and high contrast
Focus mode and live word, character and reading-time counts

features.title: Templates and examples
features.text: A starter gallery of the project's own documents and databases.
bullets: 90 templates in eleven categories
14 example projects added with one click
Any page saved as a template, row templates with a default

parity.summary: Measured line by line against Notion, Form.md was graded 65 of 67 at v0.11.0, and the page reports changes through v0.47.0 including thirteen chart kinds, 90 templates, 34 MCP tools and 26 languages. Still partial: emoji icons (refused by design), the map view, and AI search, which reaches the web but no connected apps.

requirements: Xcode Command Line Tools on a Mac, WebKitGTK 4.1 on Linux
docs.agents: Form.md is an MCP server with OAuth 2.1; `form-md mcp` is a stdio bridge, and the repo carries CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .mcp.json and a Cursor rule.

topics.title: Shortcuts
topics.text: The README lists the keys, such as Ctrl+K for search, Ctrl+Shift+P to find a command, Ctrl+Shift+F for focus mode and Ctrl+J for the terminal and Claude Code panel.

topics.title: Configuration
topics.text: Environment variables such as FORMMD_DATA, which sets the data directory for the database and uploads, default ./data.

topics.title: Ports
topics.text: The dev client runs on 127.0.0.1:5750, the server on 127.0.0.1:8750 and the client preview on 127.0.0.1:5751.

topics.title: Servers
topics.text: An installer script for servers, and a Docker option, are documented in the README.

topics.title: Wiki
topics.text: An operator and developer wiki lives in .docs/wiki and is checked against the code by make check.

shots_wanted.what: A page open in the block editor
shots_wanted.how: Run ./form-md, open http://127.0.0.1:5750, create a page from Home and type / to open the slash menu.

shots_wanted.what: A database in board or table view with a chart
shots_wanted.how: Open Templates in the sidebar, add one of the example projects such as the sales pipeline with one click, and open its database.

shots_wanted.what: The Claude Code or agent panel beside a page
shots_wanted.how: In the running app press Ctrl+J for the terminal and Claude Code panel, or open Connected apps in Settings to show the MCP snippets.
